2. Scope and local operators

These Terms govern use of voy-pro.com and bookings made directly through VOY PRO. Budapest bookings are operated by AllGo Guided Tours Bud Kft. unless the booking confirmation states otherwise. At partner-operated destinations, the responsible local operator and contracting party are identified before a booking becomes binding. A Portugal availability request is not a confirmed booking until the responsible operator confirms it.

3. How a booking is made

The customer selects the experience, date, group composition, guide language and available departure, reviews the price and payment method, enters contact details and accepts these Terms before submitting a binding booking. Information can be corrected before submission. A booking becomes binding only when a booking confirmation is issued electronically.

4. Prices and payment

Prices are shown in EUR unless stated otherwise. The total price, discounts, private-tour surcharges and other additions are shown before confirmation. Available payment methods are displayed for the selected booking. The final binding action is labelled to make the payment obligation clear.

5. Cancellation, changes and statutory withdrawal

The cancellation and rescheduling terms displayed for the selected booking form part of the contract. Under EU consumer rules, the general 14-day statutory withdrawal right normally does not apply to leisure services reserved for a specific date or period. Any contractual cancellation right shown for the booking remains available on its stated terms.

6. Participation and safety

Participation is subject to the eligibility, age, training and safety rules shown for the experience and to any rider waiver required before participation. Guests must follow guide instructions and may not participate while impaired or otherwise unable to operate safely.

7. Operational changes

Weather, safety, traffic or public-space restrictions, staff availability or vehicle availability may require changes to route, time or operating setup. Material changes to a confirmed booking will be handled under the booking terms and mandatory consumer law.

8. Complaints and dispute resolution

Complaints may be sent to voy.pro.eu@gmail.com or to the registered office. Eligible consumer disputes may also be referred to the Budapest Conciliation Board, 1016 Budapest, Krisztina krt. 99., e-mail: bekelteto.testulet@bkik.hu, telephone: +36 1 488 2131. The former EU Online Dispute Resolution platform was discontinued on 20 July 2025.

9. Liability and mandatory rights

Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability or consumer rights where such exclusion or limitation is prohibited by applicable law. External websites and third-party services are governed by their own terms.

10. Governing law

Hungarian law applies to the website operator and Budapest bookings without depriving consumers of mandatory protections that apply under the law of their habitual residence.
